title: Rules
text: Business numbers for every module. Set them here, or let this unit follow the level above.
empty_text: Rules appear here when modules are installed.
no_match_text: Try another word or clear the filter.

bounds.not_supported: This kind of rule cannot have limits. Use Lock instead.

modes.set_hint: Applies here and to the units below, unless they set their own.
modes.lock_hint: Applies here and to every unit below. They cannot change it.
modes.constrain_hint: Units below choose their own value, but only inside these limits.

input.decimal: Enter a number like 1.5 (up to 8 decimals).
input.format: This value does not have the expected format.
input.json: This is not valid JSON. Check brackets, quotes and commas.
input.currency: Use a 3-letter currency code, e.g. BDT.
input.amount: Enter an amount with at most {digits} decimals.
input.cell_format: "{column}" has a value in the wrong format.

blocked.level_not_allowed: This rule cannot be changed at this level. It is managed higher up.
blocked.module_disabled: Turn on this rule's module first, then you can change it.
blocked.locked_by_parent: {name} locked this rule. Ask them if it needs to change.

drawer.fell_back: The value set here is outside a parent's limits, so a valid value from above is used.
drawer.no_permission: You can see this rule. Only owners can change it.
drawer.needs_approval: This is a sensitive rule. Your change takes effect after another owner approves it.
drawer.mode: What do you want to do?
drawer.bounds_invalid: Choose at least one valid limit.
drawer.country_hint: Leave empty to apply in every country.
drawer.country_invalid: Use a 2-letter country code, e.g. BD.
drawer.starts_hint: Until then the current value stays.
drawer.when_invalid: Choose a date and time in the future.
drawer.reason_placeholder: e.g. New company policy from 1 July

preview.none: No unit would see a different value.

reset.title: Use the value from above
reset.hint: Removes what is set at this level. History is kept.
reset.limits_title: Remove the limits for units below?
reset.text: "{rule}" in {org} will follow the level above again.

history.empty_text: This level has always used the inherited value.
history.restore_text: The value goes back to {value}. This is saved as a new change.

trace.intro: Each level can set, limit or lock the value. The first lock wins; otherwise the closest level that sets a value is used, inside every limit from above.

messages.reset: Now using the value from above.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.text: Sensitive rule changes wait here until another owner reviews them.
approvals.empty_text: When someone changes a sensitive rule, it shows up here.
approvals.own_request: You asked for this change. Another owner must review it.
